newsitem.title: USA: Washington hotel evacuated due to suspicious fires.
newsitem.headline: Washington hotel evacuated due to suspicious fires.

text.p: A series of suspicious fires early on Sunday caused the evacuation of over 1,000 guests from the Omni Shoreham hotel in the capital, leaving at least five people injured, police and fire officials said.
The hotel near the National Zoo plays host to a number of major conventions, including last month's International Monetary Fund/ World Bank meeting.
Fire officials on the scene said four separate fires were discovered, starting just after 3 a.m. EDT, that sent smoke billowing up stairwells, cutting off exits and causing general confusion.
Officials are investigating the likelihood of arson. A truck with officers from the Bureau of Alcohol Tobacco and Firearms, which investigates suspicious fires, was sent to the scene.
Police said three firemen and two hotel guests were treated for injuries, including a broken leg.
Many of the guests were staying at the 750-room hotel while attending this weekend's unveiling of the AIDS Memorial Quilt on the Washington Mall and a rally by Latino groups near the White House.
